tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs bzhi pa bzhugs so// dpal mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo'i mgon po la rab tu 'dud do/ pra ṇa myā ṇa shrī wa rwa dī budha sh+tsa dwe ya tsakre nā thā ya/ dpag yas mkhyen pa'i bsil zer grags pa'i 'od dkar bye ba can/ /kun gsal mtha' las lhag pa'i thugs rjes nor 'dzin dge legs mdzad/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i ting 'dzin mchog gis shes bya'i de nyid gzigs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i dge mtshan brnyes pa gang der 'dud/ /shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i gnas tshul gsal bar gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pas snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i gtsug gis nor bus nye bar brten pa'i gnas/ phyi dang nang gi rig pa'i gnas rnams la legs par byang ba'i rnam dpyod 'gran zla med pas rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos tshad mar gyur pa rnams rig pa'i lam gyis rang dbang du 'grel bar mdzad pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta kīrti badz+ra zhes snyan pa'i grags pa sa gsum gyis rdo rje'i khor yug gi pha mthar son pa gang gi zhal gyis bdud rtsis skal ba bzang por gyur pa'i tshul cha tsam brjod na/ thog mar bcom ldan 'das rgyal batshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha dgu spyod pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i dbang bskur ba lan grangs du mar thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/ e pa mkhon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ye/ grags pa dpal/ sru lung pa kun smon/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' bzang po/

mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ shar mi nyag gi paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje/ des bdag sa skya lo tsa ba la'o/ /yang tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti pu pa/ thugs sras rdo rje grags pa/ mi la ras pa/ zla 'od gzhon nu/ phag mo grub pa/ 'bri khung pa/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa rgyal tshan dpal bzang po/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/ zur phug pa/ 'bar ra ba/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ g.yag mi pham sangs rgyas dpal/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ lha 'bri ba shes rab rdo rje/ mahā paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i sgrub tshul thun mong ma yin pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bde gshegs rgyal po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub pa'i rgyal mo dang / /'jig rten chos brgyad spangs pa'i rin chen bzang / /grub mchog bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi pham mgon pos rjes bzung sangs rgyas dpal/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa rong ston chos kyi rje/ /bka' drin mnyam med mkhas grub lha 'bri ba/ /mkhas mchog bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rig gnas kun mkhyen kīdhi badz+ra zhabs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' bkra shis mtshan/ 'chi med rigs skyes kun dga' bsod nams mtshan/ /mkhas grub bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa ltar ro/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ bla chen 'brog mi/ se ston kun rig zhang ston chos 'bar/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal rdor/

paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /gzungs gra lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang rdzogs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong bzhin/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin bzang / brag stengs pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rtse mo/ /rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje/ des bdag dpal sa skya lo tsā ba la'o/ /bcu gcig gsum sngags nang tshan gyi/ /bung ba rol pa'i sdebs sbyor yin/ pañtsabir+yakarasuyashasitaṃ/ dz+nyābhasobadz+rashikharatabhabaṃ/

prakārakapak+ṣabar+dhuru tsiraka ṇ+ṭhas+yabidwan+sa.ishapadanamaḥ rig gnas lnga mkhyen grags pa'i 'od dkar ni/ /khor phug rdo rje'i rtse las rab mthon te/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i mgul pa mdzes byed pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po gang gi zhabs la 'dud/ bskal par legs byas 'bum gyi rin chen du ma'i rdul brtsegs steng / /tshangs pa'i gnas gzhi'i nor bu'i khyams dang byang chub sems gnyis kyi/ /bum bzang dpag bsam ljon pa'i lo 'dab kyis brgyan lha dbang mchog /nye bar bsten pa'i chos kyi dga' tshal paṇa chen spyi bos mchod/ /gang gi legs gsung cha shas tsam/ /rna bar bsim pa'i dga' ston ni/ /'chi med dpal gyi bde ba la/ /gus pa lhod pa'i bka' drin gyur/ /srid par gnas tshe phyi nang gi /rigs gnas kun la khyed bzhin du/ /thogs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa rgyas byed shog /rje btsun chen po dpal sa skya pa las brgyud pa'i dbang / rjes gnang rnams thos pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba las/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta kīrti badz+ra'i zhal sngar rgyal ba 'dren pa 'chi med dbang po sogs nye bar nos pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gsan yig skabs bzhi pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
